content.short: Fishcake is a Web3 community focused on rewarding and engaging users through fun and interactive events.
content.description: Fishcake lowers barriers to Web3 by delivering a direct, non-intermediary campaign platform that makes tokenized marketing and incentives practical on the blockchain. It prioritizes seamless, transparent campaigns that connect merchants with local audiences without intermediaries, preserving trust and simplicity for participants. By broadcasting token reward events to nearby users, Fishcake enables on-chain incentive marketing to attract foot traffic, reward engagement, and cultivate stronger, lasting relationships with customers.
